lines.text: After inquiring of the LORD twice, David goes to Keilah, fights the Philistines, and carries off their livestock.
Saul says David has trapped himself in a town with gates and bars, and he summons all his troops to besiege Keilah.
David asks Abiathar for the ephod, learns Keilah's citizens will surrender him, and leaves with about four hundred men.
Saul's son Jonathan comes to David in Horesh, says David will be king, and they make a covenant before the LORD.
The Ziphites tell Saul at Gibeah where David hides, and after Saul breaks off pursuit, David lives in the strongholds of Engedi.
